findings.evidence: "Every case seeds and cleans its own data." repeats the Gotchas rule at line 94 ("Seed its data in the preconditions and reset it in cleanup") and the section 2 Unknown/Open Questions rule is restated at line 145
findings.fix: Cut section 8 down to checks that appear nowhere else (critical requirement to case mapping, the release gate applied), or make each item a short pointer ("section 6, first gotcha") so the same rule is not loaded twice

findings.evidence: "## 7. Optional scripts: files on disk" takes about 40 of 151 lines (two long command examples, a flag table and a five-branch run-log procedure), even though the section says to use the scripts only when the user wants a file
findings.fix: Move the flag table, the example commands and the run-log or exit-code reading procedure to references/scripts.md. Leave one line in SKILL.md: "When the user wants a Markdown file written, read references/scripts.md first". Keep the stdin-hang warning inline. The core then reads as a clean Process pattern.

findings.evidence: "- Failed-case reruns, safe reproduction and the reproduction rate follow section 3b." is a cross-reference inside Gotchas, not an environment fact that defies assumptions
findings.fix: Delete the line, or replace it with a concrete gotcha, for example: NEVER count a rerun on a fresh account as reproducing the original failure, because seeded state such as saved cards or a prior coupon is often the trigger

findings.evidence: checkout-cases assertion 1 "each with a seeded precondition" and assertion 2 "Each case lists a seeded account or data item in its preconditions" check the same thing, and no assertion checks that the empty-cart case asserts no order is created, which expected_output requires
findings.fix: Replace assertion 2 with "The empty-cart case asserts that checkout is refused and no order or charge exists afterwards" so every claim in expected_output has its own check

findings.evidence: "Reading the result, in this order:" follows the previous bullet with no blank line, so Markdown renders it as part of the single-quote bullet and the numbered exit-code procedure loses its heading
findings.fix: Insert a blank line before line 128 and make it a bold lead-in or an H3 ("### Reading the result") so the exit-code branches show as their own step

findings.evidence: The logged-run branch requires "list every flag in the logged command with its value, one per line"; the following success branch additionally requires "quote each supplied field's actual value back". Successful log reviews therefore require two exhaustive transcriptions even when all values match.
findings.fix: Default to reporting the saved path, verified critical reproduction or traceability fields, discrepancies and Open Questions. Make exhaustive flag-by-flag and field-by-field transcription conditional on an explicitly requested detailed audit.

findings.evidence: The supplied-log branch says "do not run the script again" and "Then apply the exit code below", but exit 2 instructs "fix the command and rerun"; exit 3 likewise says "create a missing directory and rerun". Following a supplied failed log reaches conflicting execution instructions.
findings.fix: Separate supplied-log review from live execution. For supplied logs, inspect the evidence and present a corrected command or directory remedy without executing it unless authorized. Limit automatic exit-2 and exit-3 retries to script runs initiated during the current task.
